Lucas's Favorite Recipes

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

   Ingredients:

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips

     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.

     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.

     - 2 teaspoons hot water

   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Daniel Dae Kim Isn’t Afraid to Fail

By John Doe | September 6, 2024

LOS ANGELES — Daniel Dae Kim sits comfortably in a sunlit room, the soft hum of a busy city just beyond the glass windows. The actor, producer, and advocate has long been a household name, but his journey to success has been anything but smooth. In fact, as Kim recounts his path, he makes one thing abundantly clear: he isn’t afraid to fail.

“If you're not failing, you're not growing,” Kim says with a smile. “The roles I didn’t get, the projects that didn’t pan out, those were the moments that pushed me to become better.”

Kim’s career spans over three decades, with standout performances in *Lost*, *Hawaii Five-0*, and most recently, the *Avatar: The Last Airbender* live-action adaptation. But behind the scenes, Kim’s contributions extend far beyond acting. He has become a vocal advocate for Asian representation in Hollywood and has stepped into the producer’s chair, ensuring that stories from marginalized communities are told authentically.

“I realized early on that if I wanted to see change, I had to be part of that change,” Kim says. His production company, 3AD, has already brought critically acclaimed series like *The Good Doctor* to audiences worldwide.

But for Kim, success didn’t come without moments of doubt. “I had to unlearn the idea that failure is final,” he says. “You audition for a hundred roles, and you might only get one callback. But that one callback can change everything.”

As the entertainment industry continues to evolve, Kim remains focused on breaking down barriers and pushing for greater inclusivity. “We still have a long way to go, but I’m hopeful,” he adds. “The more diverse our stories, the richer our culture becomes.”

Kim’s message to aspiring actors, producers, and creatives is simple: don’t fear failure. Embrace it. “It’s all part of the process,” he says. “And it’s what makes success all the more meaningful.”

John Doe is a staff writer for The New York Times, covering culture and entertainment.

Daniel Dae Kim Shines in Broadway's Yellow Face

By Public News Staff - September 4, 2024

Daniel Dae Kim, best known for his iconic roles in television hits like Lost and Hawaii Five-0, has made a triumphant return to the stage in a bold new Broadway production of David Henry Hwang’s celebrated play, Yellow Face. In this thought-provoking and poignant production, Kim takes on a challenging lead role that dives deep into the complexities of racial identity and representation in the world of entertainment.

The play, which originally premiered in 2007, remains incredibly relevant today, exploring the intersections of race, identity, and media representation in America. Kim’s performance has been met with rave reviews, with critics praising his nuanced portrayal of the struggles Asian-American actors face in an industry that has historically sidelined their talents.

A Role That Resonates

Kim has long been an advocate for increased representation of Asian-American talent in film and television. A Standing Ovation

The Broadway production of Yellow Face has been lauded for its sharp writing, its timely commentary on race, and the powerful performances by its cast. Kim’s portrayal has drawn particular attention, with theatergoers giving him standing ovations at nearly every performance.

“It’s thrilling to be back on stage,” Kim said. “There’s nothing like live theater. It’s an intimate connection between the actors and the audience that you just don’t get on screen.”

For fans of Daniel Dae Kim and theater lovers alike, Yellow Face is a must-see performance that is both entertaining and deeply thought-provoking. As the conversation around racial identity continues to evolve, plays like Yellow Face ensure that these discussions remain at the forefront of our cultural consciousness.

Bringing Yellow Face to New Audiences

As Broadway continues to recover from the impacts of the pandemic, productions like Yellow Face are a reminder of the transformative power of theater. With Kim at the helm of this critically acclaimed production, it’s clear that Broadway is once again embracing stories that matter.

Tickets for Yellow Face are available now, with performances scheduled to run through the end of the year.

This script is used to create a backup of files from a specified directory and store them in a designated backup location.

Installation

First, create a conda environment with Python 3.8 and activate it:

conda create --name backup_env python=3.8
conda activate backup_env

Next, clone the repository and install the required packages:

git clone https://github.com/backup-scripts/file-backup
cd file-backup
pip install -r requirements.txt

Usage

After installation, you can use the script to back up files from a directory:

python run_backup.py --source [SOURCE_DIRECTORY] --destination [DESTINATION_DIRECTORY]

For example, to back up the user's documents folder to the backup folder:

python run_backup.py --source /home/user/documents --destination /backup/documents

Requirements

The requirements for the script are listed in the requirements.txt file, which can be installed using pip after setting up the conda environment.

requests
shutil

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened

     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti

     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

  - Brainstorm new product ideas with the development and marketing teams.

Lucas's Favorite Recipes

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

Our goal is to increase brand awareness and drive sales through a comprehensive marketing strategy. The following steps outline our plan:

1. Digital Marketing Campaign
  - Launch targeted ads on social media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn).
  - Utilize Google AdWords for search engine marketing.
  - Develop engaging content for the company blog and email newsletters.

2. Influencer Partnerships
  - Collaborate with influencers in our industry to promote our products.
  - Offer exclusive discounts and promotional codes to their followers.

3. Content Marketing
  - Create informative videos, infographics, and whitepapers.
  - Host webinars and live Q&A sessions with industry experts.

4. SEO Optimization
  - Conduct keyword research to optimize our website content.
  - Improve site speed and mobile usability.

5. Public Relations
  - Write and distribute press releases about new product launches.

   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt

     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water

     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     - 50g unsalted butter

     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara

     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.

     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.

Lucas's Favorite Recipes

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

3. Chicken Curry
   Ingredients:
     - 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
     - 1 large onion, chopped
     - 2 cloves garlic, minced
     - 1 tablespoon ginger, minced
     - 2 tablespoons curry powder
     - 1 teaspoon ground cumin
     - 1 teaspoon ground turmeric
     - 1 teaspoon ground coriander
     - 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper
     - 1 (14.5 ounces) can diced tomatoes

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole

     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.

     - 2 teaspoons hot water

     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
